title: James Patterson The Lake House Hardcover 1st Little Brown Thriller
conditionDescription: Pre-owned hardcover with dust jacket. Normal shelf wear to the jacket and boards; pages clean and unmarked as far as inspected. Please review the photos.
descriptionText:
James Patterson - The Lake House (Little, Brown). Hardcover with dust jacket.

Six extraordinary children are trying to lead normal lives in the Rocky Mountain countryside. The only people they have ever trusted are Frannie and Kit, the couple who rescued them from unimaginable evil once before. When that evil resurfaces, the children set off for the Lake House - but even that haven may no longer be safe.

Photographed front, spine, back and both jacket flaps.
